values.name: Kim Dahlgren
values.bio: Kim Dahlgren is a Swedish freediver from Nynäshamn, a coastal town just south of Stockholm. He began in the water as a kid playing underwater rugby and has competed in depth events since 2019. He holds Swedish national records in all four depth disciplines, is a member of the Molchanovs athlete team, and spends much of the year training between Asia and Europe.
